The PLATFORM-00C support.py blob efac8e1f1f3047888a172899f8ff2fa82a15de59 is byte-identical to its 20-case focused local harness; hosted exact-head execution is UNOBSERVED.

Parent audit selected PLATFORM-00D because REQ-SCOPE-153 still lacked a shared release-artifact provenance/authenticity contract. Real package production/signing/notarization and platform acceptance remain downstream.

PLATFORM-00D is the only active increment. It validates already-produced artifact bytes against an exact canonical manifest plus independently produced manifest-authenticity evidence; it creates no signature and executes no installer/update.

ReleaseManifest requires exact release/version identity, source commit SHA, build-input digest, dependency-inventory digest and license-inventory digest. Artifact records bind exact target fingerprint, package kind, byte size and SHA-256.
Manifest fingerprint is deterministic over canonical provenance/artifact content. Changing source/build/dependency/license provenance changes the fingerprint.

ManifestAuthenticityEvidence is external verification evidence bound to the exact manifest fingerprint with verifier identity, scheme and evidence reference. Missing, UNKNOWN or UNTRUSTED authenticity fails closed.

Authenticity for another manifest revision, unknown artifact, wrong target, size mismatch and hash mismatch remain explicit distinct failures. Only exact bytes + exact target + VERIFIED exact-manifest authenticity return READY.
Artifact trust does not compare semantic versions or reject older releases; rollback/update selection belongs to APP-01 authority/lifecycle policy.

The published n0te2/artifacts.py blob a9f7efd497d9cc970cca5220d9eeb473feb6cd81 is byte-identical to the implementation that passed a 20-case local adversarial harness. Repository regressions are authored; full hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
ReleaseArtifactVerifier exposes no sign/install/update/rollback/download/execute behavior and stores no secret or signing key.
No named DAW adapter, business workflow, package builder, installer, platform signing credential, plugin host or UI is included in PLATFORM-00D.
Windows and Linux remain peer consumer platforms with macOS. Historical platform or DAW maturity has zero scheduling priority.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
